name: Datadog EU
description: Datadog EU lets agents search logs, metrics, traces, monitors, dashboards and incidents in the organization of the signed-in account. Each user signs in to their own Datadog account on the EU site (datadoghq.eu) through the browser.

prompts.text: Which services had the most errors in the last hour?
Why is the checkout latency monitor alerting?
Summarize the open incidents and their status.

apps.name: Datadog EU
apps.description: Logs, metrics, traces, monitors, and incidents, over Datadog's EU MCP server with browser sign-in.
